title: S008 reduction rule R1 is not semantics-preserving for multi-effective-fact cells
requirement_violated: A reduced intervention chain must preserve every semantic distinction the current model can observe: semanticState(derive(H)) == semanticState(derive(reduceChain(H))), stateHash equal, worldDiff empty.
description: Rule R1 ('a legal setFact/relocate keeps the LAST write per (subject, predicate) cell') assumes a write's effect is fully determined by the last write to its cell. That holds only when a cell holds at most one effective fact. When a cell holds MULTIPLE simultaneously-effective facts (overlapping validity windows), overrideFact (src/derive/world-state.ts:190) reuses the LAST matching fact's id (last by validFrom). A retractFact of that fact between two writes changes which id the later write reuses, so dropping the earlier write changes the surviving fact's identity — which is part of the effective semantic representation (the facts dimension is keyed by id).

minimal_counterexample.canon: canon/s009-overlap-baked — char/x has two facts on cell (char/x, at): f1 (validFrom null, validTo ev/b) and f2 (validFrom ev/a, validTo null). ev/a is a root (occurs); ev/b is in a REQUIRES 2-cycle with ev/c and is therefore unfounded (does not occur). Both facts are effective at baseline. inspectCanon reports errors: [] (a notice about the well-founded cycle only).

scope: Not reachable on the shipped seed canons (verrin, ordos): their multi-fact cells have DISJOINT validity windows, so at most one fact is effective at a time. It IS reachable on any valid canon the engine supports that has overlapping effective windows.
proposed_correction: Strengthen R1: refuse to subsume an earlier legal write to a cell if a retractFact of one of that cell's canon facts occurred between them (the 'multi-fact guard'). With the guard the counterexample canon is repaired (semanticEqual=true, hashEqual=true, diffEmpty=true). The guard is reported here, not silently adopted.
recommendation: Do not productionize reduceChain in its current form. If adopted, require the explicit precondition 'at most one effective fact per cell', enforced at canon validation. Prefer the architectural end-state: derive the reduced chain from the model's own fold accumulators so the reduction cannot disagree with the fold.
